1. Εγκαταστήστε το Ollama από το ollama.com/download.

shared.shell.sandbox.body.message: Ο πράκτορας εκτελεί εντολές μέσα στο δικό του περιβάλλον απομόνωσης, το οποίο μπλόκαρε αυτήν την εντολή. Η έγκρισή της στο Kage δεν μπορεί να το αλλάξει αυτό, αλλά μπορείτε να την εκτελέσετε εσείς, εκτός του περιβάλλοντος απομόνωσης. Διαβάστε πρώτα ολόκληρη την εντολή και εκτελέστε την μόνο αν την εμπιστεύεστε πλήρως.
shared.shell.sandbox.body.description: Explanation in the notice under a shell command that the AI agent's own security sandbox blocked. Kage's tool approvals only decide whether Kage asks before the agent runs something; they can't lift the agent's sandbox, so the user may run the command themselves (Kage can run it for them, outside the sandbox, after a confirm; or they copy it into a terminal). The notice can't vouch for the command (a command can print a sandbox error itself), so the user is asked to read all of it first; the full command is shown right below this text.

errors.agent_call.agent_disconnected.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent connection dropped while a request was running.

errors.agent_call.timeout.message: Ο agent δεν ολοκλήρωσε μέσα σε {seconds} δευτερόλεπτα.
errors.agent_call.timeout.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The request ran out of time. {seconds} is a number.

errors.agent_call.turn_expired.message: Το αίτημα δεν στάλθηκε μέσα σε {seconds} δευτερόλεπτα από τη σειρά του, οπότε η σειρά χάθηκε.
errors.agent_call.turn_expired.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the extension took too long to send its request after Kage gave it a turn. {seconds} is a number.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_extension.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension itself cancelled its request.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_user.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user pressed Stop now.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_user_activit.message: Διακόπηκε επειδή αρχίσατε να χρησιμοποιείτε το Kage.
errors.agent_call.cancelled_user_activit.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user started a chat prompt, which stops background requests.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_shutdown.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Kage is shutting down.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_access_off.message: Διακόπηκε επειδή η AI στο παρασκήνιο απενεργοποιήθηκε για την επέκταση {extension}.
errors.agent_call.cancelled_access_off.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user turned background AI off, or disabled or removed the extension, while a request was waiting or running.

errors.agent_call.tool_attempted.message: Ο agent προσπάθησε να χρησιμοποιήσει ένα εργαλείο, οπότε το Kage διέκοψε το αίτημα.
errors.agent_call.tool_attempted.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Background requests may not use tools; the agent started one, so Kage stopped the request.

errors.agent_call.response_too_large.message: Η απάντηση του agent ξεπέρασε τους {limit} χαρακτήρες, οπότε το Kage τη διέκοψε.
errors.agent_call.response_too_large.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent's reply was too long. {limit} is a number.

errors.agent_call.not_json.message: Η απάντηση του agent δεν ήταν JSON.
errors.agent_call.not_json.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension asked for a JSON reply, and the reply had none.

errors.agent_call.invalid_response.message: Η απάντηση του agent δεν ταίριαζε με την αναμενόμενη μορφή στο {path}.
errors.agent_call.invalid_response.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The JSON reply didn't match the extension's schema. {path} is a JSON path such as $.items[3].text; keep it verbatim.

errors.agent_call.agent_error.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent reported an error. {reason} is the agent's own text, not translated.

errors.agent_call.unknown_call.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the request id is unknown, belongs to another extension, or already finished.

errors.agent_call.not_ready.message: Δεν έχει έρθει ακόμα η σειρά αυτού του αιτήματος.
errors.agent_call.not_ready.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the extension tried to send before Kage gave the request its turn.

errors.file_text.not_granted.message: Η επέκταση {extension} δεν έχει άδεια να διαβάζει αρχεία που επιλέγετε.
errors.file_text.not_granted.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension lacks the Files you choose permission. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.file_text.extension_disabled.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension is disabled, so it can't ask for a file. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.file_text.invalid_formats.message: Ζητήθηκε άγνωστος τύπος αρχείου. Το Kage διαβάζει: {formats}.
errors.file_text.invalid_formats.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Developer-facing: the extension asked for a format Kage doesn't know. {formats} is a list of file extensions such as .txt, .md, .pdf; keep it verbatim.

errors.file_text.invalid_max_chars.message: Το όριο χαρακτήρων πρέπει να είναι μεταξύ 1 και {max}.
errors.file_text.invalid_max_chars.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Developer-facing: the extension asked for a character limit out of range. {max} is a number.

errors.file_text.busy.message: Το Kage διαβάζει ήδη ένα αρχείο. Δοκιμάστε ξανά όταν τελειώσει.
errors.file_text.busy.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Only one file can be read at a time, or the ask bar is already showing.

errors.file_text.too_soon.message: Περιμένετε λίγο πριν επιλέξετε άλλο αρχείο.
errors.file_text.too_soon.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension asked for another file within a few seconds of the last dialog.

errors.file_text.declined.message: Επιλέξατε «Όχι τώρα». Δοκιμάστε ξανά σε λίγο.
errors.file_text.declined.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user clicked Not now on the ask bar, and the extension asked again too soon. "Not now" is the button label (file_text.ask.dismiss).

errors.file_text.no_window.message: Ανοίξτε το Kage για να επιλέξετε αρχείο.
errors.file_text.no_window.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The window that would show the ask bar is hidden, so Kage didn't ask.

errors.file_text.unavailable.message: Η ανάγνωση αρχείων δεν είναι διαθέσιμη σε αυτό το αντίγραφο του Kage.
errors.file_text.unavailable.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file reader that ships with Kage is missing from the install.

errors.file_text.dialog_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατό να ανοίξει η επιλογή αρχείων.
errors.file_text.dialog_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The system's file dialog failed to open.

errors.file_text.not_a_file.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user picked a folder, a package or a device. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.unsupported.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να διαβάσει αρχεία .{ext} εδώ. Διαβάζει: {formats}.
errors.file_text.unsupported.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The picked file's type isn't one the extension asked for. {ext} is the file's extension without the dot; {formats} is a list of file extensions such as .txt, .md, .pdf. Keep both verbatim.

errors.file_text.wrong_content.message: Το {name} δεν περιέχει αυτό που υποδηλώνει η κατάληξη .{ext}.
errors.file_text.wrong_content.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file's contents don't match its extension (for example a renamed file). {name} is the file name; {ext} is its extension without the dot.

errors.file_text.too_large.message: Το {name} έχει μέγεθος {size}. Το Kage διαβάζει αρχεία έως {limit}.
errors.file_text.too_large.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file is over the size limit. {name} is the file name; {size} and {limit} are sizes such as 48.2 MB.

errors.file_text.read_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η ανάγνωση του {name}.
errors.file_text.read_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The operating system refused or failed the read. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.not_downloaded.message: Η λήψη του {name} δεν ολοκληρώθηκε. Δοκιμάστε ξανά όταν βρίσκεται σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή.
errors.file_text.not_downloaded.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file lives on a cloud drive and didn't download in time. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.encrypted.message: Το {name} προστατεύεται με κωδικό πρόσβασης. Αφαιρέστε τον κωδικό και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
errors.file_text.encrypted.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document needs a password to open. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.legacy_format.message: Το {name} χρησιμοποιεί παλιά μορφή που το Kage δεν μπορεί να διαβάσει. Αποθηκεύστε το ως .docx ή PDF και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
errors.file_text.legacy_format.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. An old binary Office file (such as .doc) saved with a new extension. {name} is the file name; keep .docx and PDF verbatim.

errors.file_text.not_text.message: Το {name} δεν φαίνεται να είναι αρχείο κειμένου.
errors.file_text.not_text.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. A file named as text holds binary data. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.malformed.message: Το {name} φαίνεται κατεστραμμένο και δεν ήταν δυνατή η ανάγνωσή του.
errors.file_text.malformed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document is broken or not what it claims to be. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.too_complex.message: Το {name} είναι πολύ σύνθετο για να διαβαστεί με ασφάλεια.
errors.file_text.too_complex.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document went over a safety limit (size, nesting or memory). {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.timeout.message: Η ανάγνωση του {name} διήρκεσε πολύ, οπότε το Kage τη διέκοψε.
errors.file_text.timeout.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Extracting the text went over the time limit. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.cancelled.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user or the extension cancelled the read. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.worker_failed.message: Η λειτουργία ανάγνωσης αρχείων σταμάτησε απροσδόκητα.
errors.file_text.worker_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Kage's separate file reader process failed or returned something it couldn't use.

errors.ext_view.opener_refused.message: Αυτό το παράθυρο δεν μπορεί να ανοίξει παράθυρα επεκτάσεων.
errors.ext_view.opener_refused.description: Opening an extension's own window from a Kage window that isn't allowed to (for example the Store).

errors.ext_view.unknown_extension.message: Δεν υπάρχει εγκατεστημένη επέκταση με όνομα {id}.
errors.ext_view.unknown_extension.description: Opening an extension window for an extension that isn't installed. {id} is the extension's id.

errors.ext_view.disabled.description: Opening an extension window for an extension the user turned off. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.ext_view.not_granted.message: Η επέκταση {extension} χρειάζεται την έγκρισή σας για να ανοίγει δικά της παράθυρα.
errors.ext_view.not_granted.description: Opening an extension window without the Its own windows permission. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.ext_view.unknown_view.message: Η επέκταση {extension} δεν έχει παράθυρο με όνομα {view}.
errors.ext_view.unknown_view.description: The extension doesn't declare the window it asked to open. {extension} is the extension's name; {view} is the window's id.

errors.ext_view.wrong_extension.message: Ένα παράθυρο επέκτασης μπορεί να ανοίξει μόνο παράθυρα της ίδιας επέκτασης.
errors.ext_view.wrong_extension.description: An extension window tried to open another extension's window.

errors.ext_view.params_invalid.message: Τα αρχικά δεδομένα του παραθύρου δεν είναι έγκυρα: {reason}
errors.ext_view.params_invalid.description: The data an extension passes to a window it opens is malformed. {reason} is a short technical reason in English.

errors.ext_view.params_too_large.message: Τα αρχικά δεδομένα του παραθύρου είναι πολύ μεγάλα ({size} byte· το όριο είναι {limit}).
errors.ext_view.params_too_large.description: The data an extension passes to a window it opens is too large. {size} and {limit} are numbers of bytes.

errors.ext_view.too_many_open.message: Υπάρχουν πάρα πολλά ανοιχτά παράθυρα επεκτάσεων (όριο {limit}). Κλείστε ένα και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
errors.ext_view.too_many_open.description: Every allowed extension window is already open and visible. {limit} is a number.

errors.ext_view.not_a_view_window.description: A command for extension windows was called from another Kage window.

errors.ext_view.not_focused.message: Το παράθυρο της επέκτασης δεν βρίσκεται σε πρώτο πλάνο.
errors.ext_view.not_focused.description: An extension window tried to copy or send text while another window had focus.

errors.ext_view.text_invalid.message: Το κείμενο δεν μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί: {reason}
errors.ext_view.text_invalid.description: Text from an extension window is too long or isn't plain text. {reason} is a short technical reason in English.

errors.ext_view.too_fast.message: Πάρα πολλά αιτήματα. Δοκιμάστε ξανά σε λίγο.
errors.ext_view.too_fast.description: An extension window copied or sent text too often in a short time.

errors.ext_view.clipboard_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αντιγραφή στο πρόχειρο.
errors.ext_view.clipboard_failed.description: Copying text from an extension window to the system clipboard failed.

errors.ext_view.geometry_write_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αποθήκευση των θέσεων των παραθύρων: {reason}
errors.ext_view.geometry_write_failed.description: Saving or resetting the size and position of extension windows failed. {reason} is a system error message.

file_text.dialog.title.description: Title of the system file dialog an extension opens. {extension} is the extension's name. On macOS it shows as the dialog's message line.

file_text.dialog.filter.description: File type filter in the system file dialog: the file types Kage can read

file_text.ask.message.message: Η επέκταση {extension} θέλει να διαβάσει ένα αρχείο της επιλογής σας.
file_text.ask.message.description: Ask bar shown when an extension asks for a file without a click. {extension} is the extension's name.

file_text.ask.choose.description: Ask bar button: open the file dialog

file_text.ask.dismiss.description: Ask bar button: don't open the file dialog

file_text.progress.reading.description: Progress chip while Kage reads a file the user picked. {file} is the file name.

file_text.progress.downloading.description: Progress chip while a cloud drive downloads the file the user picked. {file} is the file name.

file_text.progress.cancel.description: Progress chip button: stop reading the file

ext_view.window_title.description: Title of an extension's own window, in the title bar and the taskbar. {view} is the window's name; {extension} is the extension's name.

ext_view.window_title_sub.description: Title of an extension's own window when the extension adds a subtitle. {subtitle} comes from the extension; {view} is the window's name; {extension} is the extension's name.

ext_view.iframe_label.description: Accessible name of the area an extension draws in its own window. {view} is the window's name; {extension} is the extension's name.

ext_view.badge.description: Badge in the bar at the top of an extension's own window, so it can't pass for a Kage window

ext_view.badge_tip.message: Αυτό το παράθυρο δημιουργείται από την επέκταση {extension}.
ext_view.badge_tip.description: Tooltip of the Extension badge in an extension's own window. {extension} is the extension's name.

ext_view.bar.reload.description: Button in the bar of an extension's own window: start the window's content again

ext_view.bar.settings.description: Button in the bar of an extension's own window: open the extension's settings page

ext_view.bar.close.description: Button in the bar of an extension's own window: close the window

ext_view.loading.description: Shown while an extension's own window loads. {view} is the window's name.

ext_view.state.load_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατό το άνοιγμα του {view}.
ext_view.state.load_failed.description: An extension's own window failed to load. {view} is the window's name.

ext_view.state.not_responding.description: Banner when an extension's own window stops answering. {view} is the window's name.

ext_view.state.navigated.message: Το {view} προσπάθησε να εμφανίσει μια ιστοσελίδα, γι' αυτό το Kage το σταμάτησε.
ext_view.state.navigated.description: An extension's own window tried to load a web page and Kage closed its content. {view} is the window's name.

ext_view.state.removed.message: Η επέκταση {extension} δεν διαθέτει πλέον αυτό το παράθυρο.
ext_view.state.removed.description: After an update the extension no longer declares the open window. {extension} is the extension's name.

ext_view.state.updated.description: Shown briefly in an extension's own window after the extension updated. {version} is a version number such as 1.2.0.

errors.sync.unavailable.message: Ο συγχρονισμός δεν είναι διαθέσιμος αυτήν τη στιγμή.
errors.sync.unavailable.description: A sync action was refused because sync is off, locked or paused on this computer, or not in this version.

errors.sync.needs_confirmation.message: Επιβεβαιώστε πρώτα αυτήν την ενέργεια και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
errors.sync.needs_confirmation.description: A destructive sync action (turn off, start over, remove a computer) came without a fresh confirmation.

errors.sync.quota_exceeded.message: Τα συγχρονισμένα δεδομένα αυτής της επέκτασης υπερβαίνουν το όριό της.
errors.sync.quota_exceeded.description: An extension tried to sync more data than its limit allows.

settings.sync.title.description: Settings sidebar item and page title for syncing between the user's computers.

settings.sync.intro.message: Διατηρήστε τις ρυθμίσεις, τις συντομεύσεις και τις επεκτάσεις σας ίδιες σε όλους τους υπολογιστές σας.

settings.sync.no_server.message: Το Kage χρησιμοποιεί έναν φάκελο που ήδη συγχρονίζετε, όπως Dropbox, iCloud Drive ή OneDrive. Τίποτα δεν αποστέλλεται σε διακομιστή του Kage και ό,τι αποθηκεύει εκεί το Kage είναι κρυπτογραφημένο.
settings.sync.no_server.description: Settings → Sync while sync is off: how sync works. Dropbox, iCloud Drive and OneDrive are product names.

settings.sync.passphrase.lost.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να ανακτήσει αυτή τη φράση πρόσβασης. Αν τη χάσετε, μπορείτε να την αλλάξετε από οποιονδήποτε υπολογιστή εξακολουθεί να συγχρονίζεται.
settings.sync.passphrase.lost.description: Setup: warning under the new sync passphrase.

settings.sync.passphrase.wrong.message: Αυτή η φράση πρόσβασης δεν ξεκλειδώνει αυτόν τον φάκελο.
settings.sync.passphrase.wrong.description: The sync passphrase the user typed doesn't unlock the sync folder.

settings.sync.categories.per_computer.message: Αυτές οι επιλογές ισχύουν για αυτόν τον υπολογιστή. Κάθε υπολογιστής επιλέγει για τον εαυτό του.
settings.sync.categories.per_computer.description: Under the list of what syncs: the choice is made on each computer.

settings.sync.category.settings.description: Sync category: preferences, agents, app modes.

settings.sync.category.automations.description: Sync category: shortcuts, automations and custom actions.

settings.sync.category.extensions.description: Sync category: which extensions are installed, their settings and their data.

settings.sync.category.chats.description: Sync category: copies of chats, off by default.

settings.sync.join.theirs.message: Χρήση των ρυθμίσεων από τους άλλους υπολογιστές μου
settings.sync.join.theirs.description: Joining sync: the other computers' values win where they differ.

settings.sync.join.mine.message: Χρήση των ρυθμίσεων αυτού του υπολογιστή σε όλους τους υπολογιστές
settings.sync.join.mine.description: Joining sync: this computer's values win where they differ.

settings.sync.join.safe.message: Τίποτα δεν χάνεται. Οι τιμές που αντικαθίστανται μεταφέρονται στις Διενέξεις, όπου μπορείτε να τις επαναφέρετε. Μπορείτε να αναιρέσετε τη σύνδεση για 30 ημέρες.
settings.sync.join.safe.description: Joining sync: under the two choices.

settings.sync.stays_local.message: Παραμένουν σε κάθε υπολογιστή: συνδέσεις και κλειδιά API, άδειες, θέσεις παραθύρων, αρχεία καταγραφής.

settings.sync.ext.origin_mismatch.message: Εδώ είναι εγκατεστημένη μια διαφορετική επέκταση με αυτό το ID, οπότε τα δεδομένα της δεν συγχρονίζονται.
settings.sync.ext.origin_mismatch.description: Settings → Sync → Extensions: an extension with the same id came from somewhere else on this computer.

settings.sync.ext.sideload_hint.message: Ενεργοποιήστε το μόνο αν πρόκειται για την ίδια επέκταση σε όλους τους υπολογιστές σας.
settings.sync.ext.sideload_hint.description: Settings → Sync → Extensions: next to the data switch of an extension installed from a file.

settings.sync.uninstall_note.message: Τα δεδομένα της παραμένουν στον φάκελο συγχρονισμού και στους άλλους υπολογιστές σας. Για να τα διαγράψετε παντού, μεταβείτε στις Ρυθμίσεις → Συγχρονισμός → Επεκτάσεις → Κατάργηση των δεδομένων της από τον φάκελο συγχρονισμού.
settings.sync.uninstall_note.description: Added to the uninstall confirmation of an extension whose data syncs.

settings.sync_scope.all.description: Where a setting applies: every computer.

settings.sync_scope.os_only.message: {os, select, macos {Μόνο Mac} windows {Μόνο υπολογιστές Windows} other {Μόνο υπολογιστές Linux}}
settings.sync_scope.os_only.description: Where a setting applies: only computers with this OS. {os} is macos, windows or linux.

settings.sync_scope.this_computer.description: Where a setting applies: only this computer.

settings.sync_scope.per_os.message: Κάθε τύπος υπολογιστή έχει τη δική του τιμή
settings.sync_scope.per_os.description: Where a setting applies: Macs, Windows PCs and Linux PCs each have their own value (hotkeys, paths).

settings.sync_scope.not_synced.description: Tooltip of a setting that never syncs. {reason} is one of the settings.sync_scope.reason.* sentences.

settings.sync_scope.changed_everywhere.message: Άλλαξε σε όλους τους υπολογιστές σας.
settings.sync_scope.changed_everywhere.description: Toast after the user changed a setting that is shared by all their computers.

settings.sync_scope.action.all.description: Menu item: use this value on every computer.

settings.sync_scope.action.os.message: {os, select, macos {Μόνο σε Mac} windows {Μόνο σε υπολογιστές Windows} other {Μόνο σε υπολογιστές Linux}}
settings.sync_scope.action.os.description: Menu item: use this value only on computers with this OS. {os} is macos, windows or linux.

settings.sync_scope.action.use_shared.message: Χρήση της τιμής για όλους τους υπολογιστές ({value})
settings.sync_scope.action.use_shared.description: Menu item: drop this OS's own value. {value} is the shared value, as text.

settings.sync_scope.action.this_computer.description: Menu item: keep this value on this computer only.

settings.sync_scope.action.stop_this_com.description: Menu item: follow the synced value again.

settings.sync_scope.action.avail_all.description: Menu item for a list item: it exists on every computer.

settings.sync_scope.action.avail_os.message: {os, select, macos {Μόνο σε Mac} windows {Μόνο σε υπολογιστές Windows} other {Μόνο σε υπολογιστές Linux}}
settings.sync_scope.action.avail_os.description: Menu item for a list item: it exists only on computers with this OS. {os} is macos, windows or linux.

settings.sync_scope.action.avail_this_co.description: Menu item for a list item: it exists only on this computer.

settings.sync_scope.reason.writes_file.message: Ορίζει ένα αρχείο που γράφει το Kage σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή.
settings.sync_scope.reason.writes_file.description: Why a setting doesn't sync: it is a path Kage writes to.

settings.sync_scope.reason.shell_files.message: Καθορίζει αν εκτελούνται τα αρχεία εκκίνησης του shell αυτού του υπολογιστή.
settings.sync_scope.reason.shell_files.description: Why the login shell setting doesn't sync.

settings.sync_scope.reason.login_item.message: Η εκκίνηση κατά τη σύνδεση ορίζεται ξεχωριστά για κάθε υπολογιστή.
settings.sync_scope.reason.login_item.description: Why Start at login doesn't sync.

settings.sync_scope.reason.mac_workaroun.message: Παρακάμπτει ένα πρόβλημα της έκδοσης macOS αυτού του Mac.
settings.sync_scope.reason.mac_workaroun.description: Why a macOS workaround setting doesn't sync.

settings.sync_scope.reason.not_installed.description: Why a synced extension setting isn't used here.

sync.status.off.description: Sync status: not set up on this computer.

sync.status.setting_up.description: Sync status: setup is in progress.

sync.status.up_to_date.description: Sync status. {time} is a relative time such as '2 minutes ago'.

sync.status.waiting.message: Αναμονή για λήψη {count, plural, one {# αρχείου} other {# αρχείων}} από τον υπολογιστή {computer}
sync.status.waiting.description: Sync status: the sync app hasn't downloaded files yet. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.status.placeholders.message: Ο φάκελος συγχρονισμού σας δεν έχει κατεβάσει ακόμα ορισμένα αρχεία
sync.status.placeholders.description: Sync status: some files in the sync folder are online-only.

sync.status.paused.description: Sync status. {time} is a date and time.

sync.status.paused_forever.description: Sync status: paused until the user resumes.

sync.status.locked.message: Εισαγάγετε τη φράση πρόσβασης συγχρονισμού για να συνεχιστεί ο συγχρονισμός
sync.status.locked.description: Sync status: the key isn't available on this computer.

sync.status.folder_missing.message: Δεν βρέθηκε ο φάκελος συγχρονισμού σας

sync.status.folder_denied.message: Το Kage δεν έχει άδεια να ανοίξει τον φάκελο συγχρονισμού σας
sync.status.folder_denied.description: Sync status: the OS denied access.

sync.status.folder_empty.message: Ο φάκελος συγχρονισμού σας δεν περιέχει πλέον δεδομένα του Kage
sync.status.folder_empty.description: Sync status: the Kage Sync folder was emptied.

sync.status.reset.message: Ο συγχρονισμός ξεκίνησε από την αρχή στον υπολογιστή {computer}
sync.status.reset.description: Sync status. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.status.removed.message: Αυτός ο υπολογιστής αφαιρέθηκε από τον συγχρονισμό στον υπολογιστή {computer}
sync.status.removed.description: Sync status. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.status.update_required.message: Ενημερώστε το Kage σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή για να συνεχιστεί ο συγχρονισμός
sync.status.update_required.description: Sync status: another computer uses a newer sync format.

sync.status.disk_full.message: Ο δίσκος σας είναι πλήρης. Ο συγχρονισμός θα συνεχιστεί όταν υπάρξει χώρος.

sync.status.write_failed.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να γράψει στον φάκελο συγχρονισμού σας

sync.status.folder_reverting.message: Η εφαρμογή συγχρονισμού σας αναιρεί συνεχώς τα αρχεία του Kage
sync.status.folder_reverting.description: Sync status: the cloud app keeps rolling the folder back.

sync.status.other_engine.message: Ένα άλλο αντίγραφο του Kage συγχρονίζει αυτό το προφίλ
sync.status.other_engine.description: Sync status: a second Kage on this computer uses the same profile.

sync.problem.clock_warning.message: Το ρολόι του υπολογιστή {computer} αποκλίνει περίπου {minutes, plural, one {# λεπτό} other {# λεπτά}}. Οι αλλαγές του ενδέχεται να υπερισχύσουν νεότερων αλλαγών.
sync.problem.clock_warning.description: Sync problem. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.problem.unreadable.message: {count, plural, one {# αρχείο} other {# αρχεία}} από τον υπολογιστή {computer} δεν είναι δυνατό να διαβαστούν. Το Kage χρησιμοποιεί τα υπόλοιπα δεδομένα του.
sync.problem.unreadable.description: Sync problem. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.title.description: Title of the sync conflicts list.

sync.conflicts.intro.message: Όταν δύο υπολογιστές άλλαξαν το ίδιο στοιχείο, το Kage κράτησε την πιο πρόσφατη αλλαγή. Η άλλη αποθηκεύεται εδώ για 90 ημέρες.
sync.conflicts.intro.description: Top of the sync conflicts list.

sync.conflicts.tab.replaced.description: Conflicts tab: values replaced by a newer change.

sync.conflicts.tab.deleted.description: Conflicts tab: items deleted in the last 30 days.

sync.conflicts.tab.resolved.description: Conflicts tab: entries restored or dismissed.

sync.conflicts.generated.description: Conflicts group for documents Kage writes itself, such as what it learned about the user.

sync.conflicts.private_item.description: Label of a private extension item in the conflicts list.

sync.conflicts.now.description: Conflict entry: the current value. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.replaced.description: Conflict entry: the value that was replaced. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.now_changed.description: Conflict entry for an item: the current version.

sync.conflicts.replaced_changed.description: Conflict entry for an item: the replaced version.

sync.conflicts.kind.concurrent_edit.description: Conflict entry title: one setting or item changed on two computers. {scope} is where it applies, such as 'All computers'.

sync.conflicts.kind.edit_vs_delete.message: Το στοιχείο {item} διαγράφηκε στον υπολογιστή {deleter}. Είχε αλλάξει στον υπολογιστή {editor}.
sync.conflicts.kind.edit_vs_delete.description: Conflict entry. {deleter} and {editor} are computer names.

sync.conflicts.kind.delete_vs_edit.message: Διαγράψατε το στοιχείο {item} στον υπολογιστή {deleter}. Άλλαξε αργότερα στον υπολογιστή {editor}, οπότε επανήλθε.
sync.conflicts.kind.delete_vs_edit.description: Conflict entry. {deleter} and {editor} are computer names.

sync.conflicts.kind.replaced_on_join.message: Σύνδεση με {computer}: {count, plural, one {1 ρύθμιση διέφερε} other {# ρυθμίσεις διέφεραν}}.
sync.conflicts.kind.replaced_on_join.description: Grouped conflict entry after joining sync. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.kind.restore_backup.message: Έγινε επαναφορά αντιγράφου ασφαλείας στον υπολογιστή {computer}: {count, plural, one {αντικαταστάθηκε 1 ρύθμιση} other {αντικαταστάθηκαν # ρυθμίσεις}}.
sync.conflicts.kind.restore_backup.description: Grouped conflict entry after a backup import. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.kind.replaced_by_restore.message: Έγινε επαναφορά παλαιότερης τιμής του στοιχείου {item}. Αντικαταστάθηκε: {value}.
sync.conflicts.kind.replaced_by_restore.description: Conflict entry after the user restored an older value.

sync.conflicts.kind.deleted_while_away.message: Ο υπολογιστής {computer} δεν είχε συγχρονιστεί από {date}. {count, plural, one {Αφαιρέθηκε από αυτόν 1 στοιχείο που είχε διαγραφεί αλλού} other {Αφαιρέθηκαν από αυτόν # στοιχεία που είχαν διαγραφεί αλλού}}.
sync.conflicts.kind.deleted_while_away.description: Grouped conflict entry for a computer that came back after a long time. {computer} is a computer's name.

sync.conflicts.restore.description: Conflict entry button: bring the replaced version back.

sync.conflicts.dismiss.description: Conflict entry button: keep the current version.

sync.conflicts.delete_anyway.description: Conflict entry button: delete an item that came back because another computer changed it.

sync.conflicts.compare.description: Conflict entry button: show both versions side by side.

sync.review.runnable_title.message: {count, plural, one {1 συγχρονισμένο στοιχείο μπορεί να εκτελεί προγράμματα σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή} other {# συγχρονισμένα στοιχεία μπορούν να εκτελούν προγράμματα σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή}}
sync.review.runnable_title.description: Needs your attention: synced agents, scripts or automations wait for approval here.

sync.review.mass_delete.message: Ο υπολογιστής {computer} διέγραψε {count, plural, one {1 στοιχείο} other {# στοιχεία}} από: {what}.
sync.review.mass_delete.description: Needs your attention: a bulk delete from another computer waits for an answer. {computer} is a computer's name; {what} is a list name.

tray.sync_status.description: Disabled tray menu line. {status} is a short sync status, such as 'Up to date'.

tray.sync_now.description: Tray menu item: sync with the other computers now.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.filter.u.description: Filter option in the tool-permission audit log: entries for commands the user ran themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.summary..message: Εκτελέσατε μια εντολή εκτός του περιβάλλοντος απομόνωσης του πράκτορα
settings.tool_permissions.audit.summary..description: Audit log entry: the user ran a command themselves from Kage (one the AI agent's sandbox had refused). The command follows below it.
Audit log entry: the user had Kage open the command in the macOS Terminal app. The command follows below it.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.meta.exi.description: Detail of an audit log entry for a command the user ran: its numeric exit code.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.meta.sto.description: Detail of an audit log entry for a command the user ran: they stopped it.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.meta.tim.description: Detail of an audit log entry for a command the user ran: Kage ended it at the time limit.

settings.tool_permissions.audit.meta.not.description: Detail of an audit log entry for a command the user ran: it couldn't be started.

shared.shell.sandbox.run_here.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Primary button: opens a confirm, and on approval Kage runs the command itself, outside the agent's sandbox, and shows the output.

shared.shell.sandbox.run_again.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. The same button after the command already ran once from here. Opens the confirm again.

shared.shell.sandbox.run_terminal.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. macOS only: opens a new window of the Terminal app and runs the command there (after a confirm). 'Terminal' is the macOS app's name.

shared.shell.sandbox.run_terminal_title.message: Ανοίγει ένα νέο παράθυρο του Τερματικού και εκτελεί εκεί την εντολή, όπου μπορεί να σας ζητήσει δεδομένα εισόδου. Την πρώτη φορά, το macOS ρωτά αν το Kage επιτρέπεται να ελέγχει το Τερματικό.
shared.shell.sandbox.run_terminal_title.description: Tooltip of the Run in Terminal button (macOS). Kage sends Terminal an Apple Event, which makes macOS show a one-time permission prompt (Privacy & Security → Automation).

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.title.message: Εκτέλεση αυτής της εντολής εκτός του περιβάλλοντος απομόνωσης του πράκτορα;
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.title.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Its heading. The full command is shown right below it.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.title_termi.message: Εκτέλεση αυτής της εντολής στο Τερματικό;
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.title_termi.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Its heading when the command will run in the macOS Terminal app instead of inside Kage.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.cwd_label.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Label before the folder the command starts in (shown as a path).

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.shell.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. After the working directory: which shell program runs it. {shell} is a program name such as zsh, bash or PowerShell.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.warning.message: Το Kage την εκτελεί για εσάς, εκτός του περιβάλλοντος απομόνωσης του πράκτορα, με όλα τα δικαιώματά σας: μπορεί να διαβάσει, να αλλάξει ή να διαγράψει οτιδήποτε έχει πρόσβαση ο λογαριασμός χρήστη σας. Εκτελέστε την μόνο αν την εμπιστεύεστε πλήρως.
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.warning.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. The main warning.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.warning_ter.message: Εκτελείται στο Τερματικό, εκτός του περιβάλλοντος απομόνωσης του πράκτορα, με όλα τα δικαιώματά σας: μπορεί να διαβάσει, να αλλάξει ή να διαγράψει οτιδήποτε έχει πρόσβαση ο λογαριασμός χρήστη σας. Εκτελέστε την μόνο αν την εμπιστεύεστε πλήρως.
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.warning_ter.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. The main warning when it will run in the macOS Terminal app.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.tell_agent.message: Ενημέρωση του πράκτορα για το αποτέλεσμα
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.tell_agent.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Checkbox, on by default: after the run, send the exit code and output to the AI agent as the user's next message so it can continue.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.cwd_error.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Shown instead of the working directory when that folder can't be used. {error} says why (e.g. the folder doesn't exist).

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.busy.message: Εκτελείται ήδη άλλη εντολή σε αυτό το παράθυρο. Περιμένετε να ολοκληρωθεί ή διακόψτε την πρώτα.
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.busy.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Shown when another command the user started from Kage is still running; only one runs at a time per window.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.long.message: Είναι μεγάλη εντολή ({lines, plural, one {# γραμμή} other {# γραμμές}}). Κάντε κύλιση σε όλη την εντολή πριν την εκτελέσετε.
shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.long.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Shown under the command box when the command is too long to fit in it, so the user scrolls to read the rest. {lines} is the number of lines in the command.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.cancel.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Button that closes the confirm without running anything.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.run.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Button that runs the command, outside the agent's sandbox.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo.message: Χρησιμοποιεί sudo: το Τερματικό θα σας ζητήσει τον κωδικό πρόσβασής σας και η εντολή θα εκτελεστεί ως διαχειριστής.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command using sudo (run as administrator), when it will run in the Terminal app.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here.message: Χρησιμοποιεί sudo, που απαιτεί τον κωδικό πρόσβασής σας, και εδώ δεν υπάρχει τερματικό για να τον πληκτρολογήσετε. Εκτελέστε την στο Τερματικό.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command using sudo when the user chose to run it inside Kage, which can't ask for a password; the confirm offers Run in Terminal instead of Run.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here_copy.message: Χρησιμοποιεί sudo, που απαιτεί τον κωδικό πρόσβασής σας, και εδώ δεν υπάρχει τερματικό για να τον πληκτρολογήσετε. Αντιγράψτε την σε ένα τερματικό.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here_copy.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. Same as the sudo warning, on systems where Kage can't run it in a terminal app; the confirm offers Copy & open Terminal instead of Run.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.rm_rf.message: Διαγράφει αρχεία και φακέλους αναδρομικά, χωρίς ερώτηση (rm -rf). Ελέγξτε κάθε διαδρομή που περιέχει.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.rm_rf.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command that deletes recursively and forcibly. 'rm -rf' is the literal command; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.pipe_to_shell.message: Κατεβάζει ένα script και το εκτελεί αμέσως. Εκτελέστε την μόνο αν εμπιστεύεστε την προέλευσή του.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.pipe_to_shell.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command like 'curl … | sh' that downloads code from the internet and executes it immediately.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.recursive_root.message: Αλλάζει τα δικαιώματα ή τον κάτοχο όλων των στοιχείων κάτω από έναν φάκελο ανώτατου επιπέδου ή τον αρχικό φάκελο (chmod/chown -R). Αυτό μπορεί να χαλάσει το σύστημά σας ή να σας κλειδώσει έξω από τα αρχεία σας.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.recursive_root.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For chmod/chown -R on / , a top-level folder or the home folder. 'chmod/chown -R' is literal; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.shell_rc.message: Αλλάζει ένα αρχείο εκκίνησης του shell (όπως το ~/.zshrc), κάτι που επηρεάζει κάθε τερματικό που θα ανοίγετε από εδώ και πέρα.
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.shell_rc.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command that writes to a shell configuration file. '~/.zshrc' is a file name; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.opening.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status while Kage hands the command to the macOS Terminal app.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.sent.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status once the macOS Terminal app took the command. Kage doesn't see its output.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η εκτέλεση στο Τερματικό: {error}
shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.failed.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status when handing the command to the Terminal app failed. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.running.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). While it runs.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.stopping.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). After the user pressed Stop, until it has ended.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.stop.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Button that ends the running command.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.succeeded.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished successfully. 'exit code 0' is the program's result code.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.exit_code.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished with an error. {code} is the program's numeric exit code.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.signal.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). The program was killed by an operating-system signal. {signal} is its number.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.unknown.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished but its result code isn't known.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.cancelled.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). The user pressed Stop and it was ended.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.timed_out.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It ran too long and Kage ended it. {minutes} is the limit in minutes.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.failed.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It didn't start. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.earlier_output.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Marker at the top of the output view when only its end is shown.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output_yet.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Placeholder in the output view while the command runs and hasn't printed anything.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Placeholder in the output view when the finished command printed no output.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sending.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Shown while that message is being sent.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.queued.message: Ο agent είναι απασχολημένος. Το Kage θα τον ενημερώσει για το αποτέλεσμα όταν τελειώσει η σειρά του.
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.queued.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Shown while the agent is still answering, so the message waits.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.dont_tell.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Button that drops the waiting message, so the agent isn't told.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sent.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. The message was sent.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η ενημέρωση του πράκτορα: {error}
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.failed.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Sending the message failed. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.not_told.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. The user chose not to send it (or dropped it).

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.stopped_not_t.message: Το διακόψατε, οπότε ο πράκτορας δεν ενημερώθηκε.
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.stopped_not_t.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. After the user pressed Stop, Kage doesn't send the result on its own.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.tell.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Button that sends the result to the agent now.

errors.user_shell.not_allowed.message: Οι εντολές μπορούν να εκτελεστούν μόνο από τα παράθυρα συνομιλίας και εκκίνησης του Kage.
errors.user_shell.not_allowed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. The request came from a window that isn't allowed to run commands.

errors.user_shell.empty_command.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox.

errors.user_shell.command_too_long.message: Η εντολή είναι πολύ μεγάλη για να εκτελεστεί εδώ (πάνω από {max_kib} KB).
errors.user_shell.command_too_long.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {max_kib} is the size limit in kilobytes.

errors.user_shell.invalid_command.message: Η εντολή περιέχει χαρακτήρα NUL, οπότε δεν μπορεί να εκτελεστεί.
errors.user_shell.invalid_command.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. NUL is the zero character, which no command line can contain.

errors.user_shell.invalid_run_id.message: Δεν είναι δυνατή η αναγνώριση αυτής της εκτέλεσης.
errors.user_shell.invalid_run_id.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Internal: the window sent a malformed id for the run.

errors.user_shell.no_home.message: Δεν βρέθηκε ο αρχικός σας φάκελος.
errors.user_shell.no_home.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox.

errors.user_shell.cwd_not_absolute.message: Ο κατάλογος εργασίας δεν είναι πλήρης διαδρομή: {path}
errors.user_shell.cwd_not_absolute.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the folder the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.cwd_missing.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the folder the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.cwd_not_directory.message: Ο κατάλογος εργασίας δεν είναι φάκελος: {path}
errors.user_shell.cwd_not_directory.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the path the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.busy.message: Εκτελείται ήδη άλλη εντολή σε αυτό το παράθυρο.
errors.user_shell.busy.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Only one runs at a time per window.

errors.user_shell.spawn_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η εκκίνηση της εντολής: {error}
errors.user_shell.spawn_failed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {error} is the operating system's error message.

errors.user_shell.terminal_unsupported.message: Η εκτέλεση εντολής στο τερματικό δεν υποστηρίζεται σε αυτό το σύστημα. Αντιγράψτε την εντολή.
errors.user_shell.terminal_unsupported.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Run in Terminal is macOS only.

errors.user_shell.terminal_control_chars.message: Αυτή η εντολή περιέχει tab ή άλλον χαρακτήρα ελέγχου, τον οποίο το Τερματικό θα ερμήνευε ως πάτημα πλήκτρου. Αντιγράψτε την εντολή.
errors.user_shell.terminal_control_chars.description: Error from Run in Terminal, for a command the user chose to run themselves outside the AI agent's sandbox. Terminal types the command into the shell as if it were typed on the keyboard, so a tab would trigger completion; such a command is only copied.

errors.user_shell.terminal_not_authorize.message: Το macOS δεν επέτρεψε στο Kage να ελέγξει το Τερματικό. Επιτρέψτε το στις Ρυθμίσεις συστήματος → Απόρρητο και ασφάλεια → Αυτοματοποίηση ή αντιγράψτε την εντολή.
errors.user_shell.terminal_not_authorize.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. macOS refused Kage's request to control the Terminal app. Keep the System Settings path as macOS names it.

errors.user_shell.terminal_failed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {error} is the error macOS reported.

errors.agent_call.field_invalid.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: one field of the request has characters or a shape Kage doesn't accept. {field} is the field name.

errors.ext_view.needs_user_action.message: Κάντε πρώτα κλικ ή πατήστε ένα πλήκτρο στο παράθυρο.
errors.ext_view.needs_user_action.description: An extension window tried to open a window, copy text or send text to the launcher without a recent click or key press from the user.

ext_view.state.approve.description: Button in an extension's own window when the extension needs the user's approval to open it. Opens the Store, where the user reviews and approves what the extension asks to do.

settings.sync.folder.reason.missing.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: why the picked folder can't be used.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_a_folder.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the picked path, or the “Kage Sync” inside it, is a file.

settings.sync.folder.reason.drive_root.message: Επιλέξτε έναν φάκελο, όχι τη ρίζα μιας μονάδας δίσκου.
settings.sync.folder.reason.drive_root.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the user picked a drive root such as C:\ or /.

settings.sync.folder.reason.kage_folder.message: Αυτός είναι ένας από τους φακέλους του ίδιου του Kage. Επιλέξτε έναν φάκελο που συγχρονίζει η εφαρμογή συγχρονισμού σας.
settings.sync.folder.reason.kage_folder.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is inside Kage's settings or data folders.

settings.sync.folder.reason.temp.message: Αυτός είναι ένας προσωρινός φάκελος. Τα αρχεία του μπορεί να διαγραφούν ανά πάσα στιγμή.
settings.sync.folder.reason.temp.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is inside the system's temporary folder.

settings.sync.folder.reason.read_only.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να δημιουργήσει αρχεία σε αυτόν τον φάκελο.
settings.sync.folder.reason.read_only.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is read-only.

settings.sync.folder.reason.denied.message: Το Kage δεν έχει άδεια να ανοίξει αυτόν τον φάκελο.
settings.sync.folder.reason.denied.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the OS denied access to the folder.

settings.sync.folder.reason.unreadable.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να διαβάσει αυτόν τον φάκελο.
settings.sync.folder.reason.unreadable.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: listing or reading the folder failed for another reason.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_respondi.message: Αυτός ο φάκελος δεν αποκρίνεται. Βεβαιωθείτε ότι η εφαρμογή συγχρονισμού σας εκτελείται και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
settings.sync.folder.reason.not_respondi.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: reading the folder timed out (for example a stalled cloud drive).

settings.sync.folder.reason.inside_sync.message: Αυτός ο φάκελος βρίσκεται μέσα σε έναν φάκελο «Kage Sync». Επιλέξτε τον φάκελο που περιέχει το «Kage Sync».
settings.sync.folder.reason.inside_sync.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the user picked a folder inside Kage's own sync folder structure. “Kage Sync” is the folder name and stays untranslated.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_download.message: Η λήψη αυτού του φακέλου δεν έχει ολοκληρωθεί. Δοκιμάστε ξανά σε λίγο.
settings.sync.folder.reason.not_download.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the sync folder's files are still placeholders in the cloud app.

settings.sync.folder.reason.incomplete.message: Από αυτόν τον φάκελο «Kage Sync» λείπει ένα αρχείο. Περιμένετε να ολοκληρωθεί η εφαρμογή συγχρονισμού σας ή επιλέξτε άλλον φάκελο.
settings.sync.folder.reason.incomplete.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder has computers' data but no kage-sync.json. “Kage Sync” is the folder name and stays untranslated.

errors.host_command.not_pending.message: Αυτό το αίτημα δεν περιμένει πλέον απάντηση.
errors.host_command.not_pending.description: Error when the user answers a prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox, but the request already ended (answered, timed out or withdrawn).

errors.host_command.wrong_window.message: Αυτό το αίτημα εμφανίζεται σε άλλο παράθυρο. Απαντήστε εκεί.
errors.host_command.wrong_window.description: Error when the user answers a prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox from a different Kage window than the one showing it.

errors.host_command.hidden_chars.message: Αυτή η εντολή περιέχει κρυφούς χαρακτήρες, οπότε το Kage δεν θα την εκτελέσει. Αντιγράψτε την αντί γι' αυτό.
errors.host_command.hidden_chars.description: Error: a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox contains invisible characters (control, bidi or zero-width characters), so it can't be run from Kage.

errors.host_command.cannot_always.message: Το Kage δεν μπορεί να δημιουργήσει κανόνα για αυτή την εντολή. Εκτελέστε την μία φορά αντί γι' αυτό.
errors.host_command.cannot_always.description: Error: the user picked 'Always allow' for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox, but no rule can cover it (it may touch credentials, or isn't a simple command).

errors.host_command.bad_prefix.message: Αυτό δεν μπορεί να είναι κανόνας: χρησιμοποιήστε απλές λέξεις, χωρίς σύμβολα όπως ; | & $ > ή αλλαγές γραμμής.
errors.host_command.bad_prefix.description: Error: the words the user typed for an 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule aren't a simple command.

errors.host_command.prefix_mismatch.message: Αυτή η εντολή δεν ξεκινά με αυτές τις λέξεις.
errors.host_command.prefix_mismatch.description: Error: the user edited the words of an 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule so that the command being approved no longer starts with them.

errors.host_command.bad_decision.message: Το Kage δεν κατάλαβε αυτή την απάντηση.
errors.host_command.bad_decision.description: Internal error: the prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox sent an unknown answer.

errors.host_command.too_many_rules.message: Υπάρχουν ήδη πάρα πολλοί κανόνες. Αφαιρέστε μερικούς στις Ρυθμίσεις → Δικαιώματα εργαλείων.
errors.host_command.too_many_rules.description: Error: the user tried to add another 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule but the list is full. Keep the Settings path as the app names it.

errors.host_command.allow_all_settings_o.message: Αυτό μπορεί να ενεργοποιηθεί μόνο από τις Ρυθμίσεις.
errors.host_command.allow_all_settings_o.description: Error: the switch that lets every command an AI agent asks for run without asking can only be turned on from the Settings window.

host_commands.notify.title.message: Το {agent} θέλει να εκτελέσει μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
host_commands.notify.title.description: System notification title. {agent} is the name of the AI agent program (for example kiro-cli) that asked Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox.

host_commands.notify.title_unknown.message: Ένας agent θέλει να εκτελέσει μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
host_commands.notify.title_unknown.description: System notification title when Kage doesn't know which AI agent asked it to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox.

host_commands.notify.body.message: Ανοίξτε το Kage για να την ελέγξετε. Τίποτα δεν εκτελείται χωρίς την έγκρισή σας.
host_commands.notify.body.description: System notification body for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox.

shared.host_command.title.message: Το {agent} θέλει να εκτελέσει μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
shared.host_command.title.description: Heading of the prompt shown when an AI agent asks Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox (its sandbox refused the command). {agent} is the agent's name, for example Kiro.

shared.host_command.title_unknown.message: Ένας agent θέλει να εκτελέσει μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
shared.host_command.title_unknown.description: Heading of the prompt shown when an AI agent asks Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox, when Kage doesn't know which agent asked.

shared.host_command.auto_title.message: Το {agent} εκτελεί μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
shared.host_command.auto_title.description: Heading shown when Kage runs a command an AI agent asked for, outside the agent's sandbox, without asking (a rule the user made covers it). {agent} is the agent's name.

shared.host_command.auto_title_unknown.message: Ένας agent εκτελεί μια εντολή εκτός του sandbox του
shared.host_command.auto_title_unknown.description: Heading shown when Kage runs a command an AI agent asked for, outside the agent's sandbox, without asking, when Kage doesn't know which agent asked.

shared.host_command.unmatched.message: Αυτό το αίτημα δεν προήλθε από κάποια συνομιλία του Kage, οπότε δεν ισχύει κανένας κανόνας για αυτό.
shared.host_command.unmatched.description: Note in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: Kage couldn't tie the request to one of its own conversations (for example an agent running in a terminal).

shared.host_command.background.message: Προήλθε από μια εργασία παρασκηνίου που επεξεργάζεται κείμενο από άλλη εφαρμογή, οπότε δεν ισχύει κανένας κανόνας για αυτό.
shared.host_command.background.description: Note in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: the request came from a hidden background task (inline assist, a macro…) that works on text from other apps.

shared.host_command.reason_label.description: Label in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, before the agent's own explanation of why its sandbox can't run it. The explanation follows in the agent's words.

shared.host_command.run_once.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: run it this one time.

shared.host_command.always.message: Να επιτρέπονται πάντα οι εντολές που ξεκινούν με
shared.host_command.always.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: run it, and from now on run commands that start with the words in the text field next to it without asking. The field follows the button.

shared.host_command.prefix_label.message: Λέξεις με τις οποίες πρέπει να ξεκινούν οι εντολές
shared.host_command.prefix_label.description: Accessible label of the editable text field next to the 'Always allow commands starting with' button: the first words of a command, for example 'brew install'.

shared.host_command.deny.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: don't run it.

shared.host_command.expires.message: Αν δεν απαντήσετε μέσα σε {minutes, plural, one {# λεπτό} other {# λεπτά}}, το Kage θα απορρίψει το αίτημα.
shared.host_command.expires.description: Line in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox. {minutes} is the time left before Kage denies the request on its own.

shared.host_command.guard.message: Αυτή η εντολή ενδέχεται να αγγίζει διαπιστευτήρια ({kinds}). Το Kage ρωτά πάντα πριν εκτελέσει μια τέτοια εντολή, ανεξάρτητα από τους κανόνες σας.
shared.host_command.guard.description: Warning in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox. {kinds} is a comma-separated list such as 'AWS credentials, SSH keys'.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.aws.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.sandbox_s.message: την περίοδο λειτουργίας του sandbox διαπιστευτηρίων
shared.host_command.guard_kind.sandbox_s.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: the session file of the sandbox that holds the agent's credentials.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.ssh.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.netrc.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning. Keep '.netrc' as is (a file name).

shared.host_command.guard_kind.git.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.gcloud.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.cloud.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: Azure, Kubernetes or Docker credential files.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.keychain.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: the macOS keychain, where passwords are stored.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.env_dump.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: the command prints every environment variable, which can include secrets.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.credentia.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: environment variables that hold secrets, such as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

shared.host_command.guard_kind.hidden_gl.description: Item in the list of what a command may touch, in the credential warning: a wildcard into hidden folders, where credentials are often kept.

shared.host_command.by_rule.message: Επιτράπηκε από τον κανόνα σας: εντολές που ξεκινούν με «{rule}».
shared.host_command.by_rule.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, run without asking because of a rule the user made. {rule} is the rule's words, for example 'brew install'.

shared.host_command.by_allow_all.message: Επιτράπηκε επειδή επιτρέψατε την εκτέλεση κάθε εντολής χωρίς ερώτηση.
shared.host_command.by_allow_all.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, run without asking because the user turned on 'Run every command without asking' in Settings.

shared.host_command.starting.description: Status after the user approved a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, until it starts.

shared.host_command.rule_added.message: Από τώρα και στο εξής, οι εντολές που ξεκινούν με «{rule}» εκτελούνται χωρίς ερώτηση.
shared.host_command.rule_added.description: Status after the user chose 'Always allow commands starting with …'. {rule} is the words they allowed, for example 'brew install'.

shared.host_command.denied.description: Status after the user denied a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox.

shared.host_command.closed.message: Αυτό το αίτημα δεν περιμένει πλέον απάντηση.
shared.host_command.closed.description: Status when the user answers a prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, but the request already ended.

shared.host_command.expired.message: Δεν δόθηκε απάντηση εγκαίρως, οπότε το Kage απέρριψε το αίτημα.
shared.host_command.expired.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: the prompt went unanswered for five minutes and Kage denied it.

shared.host_command.withdrawn.message: Ο agent σταμάτησε να περιμένει απάντηση.
shared.host_command.withdrawn.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: the agent gave up (its turn was stopped) before the user answered.

shared.host_command.busy.message: Εκτελούνταν ήδη πάρα πολλές εντολές, οπότε το Kage απέρριψε το αίτημα.
shared.host_command.busy.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, refused because several were already running.

shared.host_command.shutdown.message: Το Kage τερματίζεται, οπότε η εντολή δεν εκτελέστηκε.
shared.host_command.shutdown.description: Status of a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, when Kage quits before it runs.

shared.host_command.answer_failed.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αποστολή της απάντησής σας: {error}
shared.host_command.answer_failed.description: Error under the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox. {error} is the reason.

shared.host_command.result_returned.description: Line under a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, once it ended: its exit code and output were returned to the agent.

shared.shell.run_chip.label.message: Μια εντολή εκτελείται ακόμη εκτός του sandbox του agent
shared.shell.run_chip.label.description: Accessible label of the compact chip that keeps a running command (with its Stop button) visible after the window cleared the answer it belonged to.

settings.tool_permissions.host.section.message: Εντολές εκτός του sandbox του agent
settings.tool_permissions.host.section.description: Settings → Tool permissions: heading of the section about commands an AI agent asks Kage to run outside the agent's own sandbox.

settings.tool_permissions.host.rules_lab.description: Settings → Tool permissions: label above the list of rules ('commands starting with …') that run without asking.

settings.tool_permissions.host.descripti.message: Όταν το sandbox του ίδιου του agent απορρίπτει μια εντολή (για παράδειγμα, μια εγκατάσταση με Homebrew), ο agent μπορεί να ζητήσει από το Kage να την εκτελέσει για εσάς. Εγκρίνετε κάθε εντολή ξεχωριστά, εκτός αν την καλύπτει κάποιος από τους παρακάτω κανόνες. Για εντολές που ενδέχεται να αγγίξουν διαπιστευτήρια, θα ερωτάστε πάντα.
settings.tool_permissions.host.descripti.description: Settings → Tool permissions: explanation of commands an AI agent asks Kage to run outside its sandbox, and of the rules listed below it.

settings.tool_permissions.host.rules_emp.message: Δεν υπάρχουν ακόμη κανόνες. Για να δημιουργήσετε έναν, επιλέξτε «Να επιτρέπονται πάντα οι εντολές που ξεκινούν με …» όταν σας ρωτήσει ο agent.
settings.tool_permissions.host.rules_emp.description: Settings → Tool permissions: shown when there are no rules for commands outside the agent's sandbox.

settings.tool_permissions.host.rule.description: Settings → Tool permissions: one rule in the list. {prefix} is the words a command must start with, for example 'brew install'.

settings.tool_permissions.host.rule_adde.description: Settings → Tool permissions: when a rule was made. {date} is a date.

settings.tool_permissions.host.remove.description: Settings → Tool permissions: button that deletes a rule for commands outside the agent's sandbox.

settings.tool_permissions.host.remove_ti.message: Να γίνεται ξανά ερώτηση πριν από την εκτέλεση εντολών που ξεκινούν με «{prefix}»
settings.tool_permissions.host.remove_ti.description: Tooltip of the button that deletes a rule. {prefix} is the rule's words.

settings.tool_permissions.host.remove_fa.message: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αφαίρεση του κανόνα: {error}
settings.tool_permissions.host.remove_fa.description: Settings → Tool permissions: error when deleting a rule fails. {error} is the reason.

settings.tool_permissions.host.allow_all.message: Εκτέλεση όλων των εντολών χωρίς ερώτηση
settings.tool_permissions.host.allow_all.description: Settings → Tool permissions: switch that lets every command an AI agent asks Kage to run outside its sandbox run without asking.

settings.tool_permissions.host.allow_all.message: Οι εντολές που ζητά ο agent θα εκτελούνται τότε με πλήρη πρόσβαση στον υπολογιστή σας — στα αρχεία σας και στα διαπιστευτήριά σας για το AWS και άλλες υπηρεσίες — χωρίς να ερωτάστε πρώτα. Για εντολές που ενδέχεται να αγγίξουν διαπιστευτήρια, καθώς και για εντολές με κρυφούς χαρακτήρες, θα ερωτάστε ακόμη.
settings.tool_permissions.host.allow_all.description: Settings → Tool permissions: plain warning under the 'Run every command without asking' switch.

settings.tool_permissions.host.allow_all.message: Να εκτελούνται χωρίς ερώτηση όλες οι εντολές που ζητά ο agent εκτός του sandbox του; Θα εκτελούνται με πλήρη πρόσβαση στον υπολογιστή σας, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των διαπιστευτηρίων σας για το AWS. Για εντολές που ενδέχεται να αγγίξουν διαπιστευτήρια, θα ερωτάστε ακόμη.
